verses.eng: "He is an man in the world, but he towers above all triple-powers and will raise himself above them all.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above all forefathers and will raise himself above them all.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above all invisibles and will raise himself above them all.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above the great invisible forefather and will raise himself above him.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above all those of the Midst and will raise himself above them all.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above the emanations of the Treasury of the Light and will raise himself above them all.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above the Mixture and will raise himself entirely above it.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above the whole region of the Treasury and will raise himself entirely above it.
"He is an man in the world, but he will rule with me in my kingdom.
"He is an man in the world, but he is king in the Light.
"He is an man in the world, but he is not one of the world.
"And amen, I say to you: That man is I and I am that man.

Such souls are one with the First Mystery. "And at the dissolution of the world, that is when the universe will be raised up and when the numbering of the perfect souls will be raised up all together, and when I am king in the midst of the last Helper, being king over all the emanations of the Light and king over the seven Amens and the five Trees and the three Amens and the nine guards, and being king over the Child of the Child, that is the Twin-saviours, and being king over the twelve saviours and over the whole numbering of the perfect souls who shall receive the mysteries in the Light,--then will all men who shall receive the mysteries in the Ineffable, be fellow-kings with me and will sit on my right and on my left in my kingdom.
"And amen, I say to you: Those men are I, and I am they.
"On this account have I said to you aforetime: 'You will sit on your thrones on my right and on my left in my kingdom and will rule with me.'

"On this account, therefore, I have not hesitated nor have I been ashamed to call you my brethren and my companions, because you will be fellow-kings with me in my kingdom. This, therefore, I say to you, knowing that I will give you the mystery of the Ineffable; that is: That mystery is I, and I am that mystery.

Of the dignity of the thrones in the kingdom. "Now, therefore, not only will you reign with me, but all men who shall receive the mystery of the Ineffable, will be fellow-kings with me in my kingdom. And I am they, and they are I. But my throne will tower over them. [And] because you will suffer sorrows in the world beyond all men, until you herald forth all the words which I shall speak to you, your thrones shall be joined to mine in my kingdom.

"On this account I have said to you aforetime: 'Where I shall be, there will be also my twelve ministers.' But Marayam Magdalene and Yawachanan, the virgin, will tower over all my disciples and over all men who shall receive the mysteries in the Ineffable. And they will be on my right and on my left. And I am they, and they are I.
"And they will be like to you in all things save that your thrones will tower over theirs, and my throne will tower over yours.
"And all men who will find the word of the Ineffable,--amen, I say to you: The men

Of the gnosis of the word of the Ineffable. who shall know that word, will know the gnosis of all these words which I have spoken to you, both those of the depth and those of the height, those of the length and those of the breadth; in a word, they will know the gnosis of all these words which I have spoken to you and which I have not yet spoken to you, which I will speak to you, region by region and order by order, at the expansion of the universe.

"And amen, I say to you: They will know in what manner the world is established, and they will know in what type all those of the height are established, and they will know out of what ground the universe has arisen."

When then the Saviour had said this, Marayam Magdalene started forward and said: "My Adanay, bear with me and be not wroth with me, if I question on all things with precision and certainty. Now, therefore, my Adanay, is then another the word of the mystery of the Ineffable and another the word of the whole gnosis?"
The Saviour answered and said: "Yea, another is the mystery of the Ineffable and another the word of the whole gnosis."

And Marayam answered again and said to the Saviour: "My Adanay, bear with me, if I question you, and be not wroth with me. Now, therefore, my Adanay, unless we live and know the gnosis of the whole word of the Ineffable, shall we not be able to inherit the Light-kingdom?"

Of the distinction between the gnosis of the universe and the mysteries of the Light. And the Saviour answered and said to Marayam: "Surely; for every one who shall receive a mystery of the Light-kingdom, will go and inherit up to the region up to which he has received mysteries. But he will not know the

gnosis of the universe, wherefor all this has arisen, unless he knows the one and only word of the Ineffable, which is the gnosis of the universe. And again in openness: I am the gnosis of the universe. And moreover it is impossible to know the one and only word of the gnosis, unless an man first receive the mystery of the Ineffable. But all the men who shall receive mysteries in the Light,--every one will go and inherit up to the region up to which he has received mysteries.

"On this account I have said to you aforetime: 'He who has faith in a prophet, will receive a prophet's reward, and he who has faith in a righteous man] will receive a righteous man's] reward,'--that is: Every one will go to the region up to which he has received mysteries. He who receives a lesser mystery, will inherit the lesser mystery, and he who receives a higher mystery, will inherit the higher regions. And every one will abide in his region in the light of my kingdom, and every one will have power over the orders which are below him, but he will not have the power to go to the orders which are above him; but he will abide in the region of the Inheritance of the Light of my kingdom, being in a great light immeasurable for the gods and all the invisibles, and he will be in great joy and great jubilation.
"But now, therefore, hearken, that I may discourse with you concerning the grandeur of those who shall receive the mysteries of the First Mystery.
"He, therefore, who shall receive the first] mystery of that First Mystery, and it shall be

Of the ascension of the souls of those who receive the twelve mysteries of the First Mystery. at the time that he comes out of the body of the matter of the rulers,--then the retributive receivers come and lead the soul of that man out of the body. And that soul will become a great light-stream in the hands of the retributive receivers; and those receivers will be afraid of the light of that soul. And that soul will go upwards and pass through all the regions of the rulers and all the regions of the emanations of the Light. And it will not give answers nor apologies nor tokens in any single region of the Light nor in any single region of the rulers; but it will pass through all the regions and cross over them all, so that it goes and rules over all the regions of the first saviour.

"In like manner also he who shall receive the second mystery of the First Mystery and the third and fourth, until he shall receive the twelfth mystery of the First Mystery, if it shall be at the time that he comes out of the body of the matter of the rulers,--then the retributive receivers come and lead the soul of that man out of the body of matter. And those souls will become a great light-stream in the hands of the retributive receivers; and those receivers will be afraid of the light of those souls and will become powerless and fall on their faces. And those souls will straightway soar upwards and cross over all the regions of the rulers and all the regions of the emanations of the Light. They will not give answers nor apologies nor tokens in any single region; but they will pass through all the regions and will cross over them all and rule over all the regions of the twelve saviours, so that they who receive the second mystery of the First
Mystery, will rule over all the regions of the second saviour in the inheritances of the Light.

"In like manner also those who receive the third mystery of the First Mystery and the fourth and fifth and sixth up to the twelfth,--every one will rule over all the regions of the saviour up to whom he has received the mystery.

"And he who shall receive in sequence the twelfth mystery of the First Mystery, that is the master-mystery concerning which I discourse with you,-- and he who, therefore, shall receive those twelve mysteries which belong to the First Mystery, if he goes forth out of the world, will pass through all the regions of the rulers and all the regions of the Light, being a great light-stream, and he will moreover rule over all the regions of the twelve saviours; but they will not be able to be like to those who receive the one and only mystery of the Ineffable. But he who shall receive those mysteries will abide in those orders, because they are exalted, and he will abide in the orders of the twelve saviours."

Marayam again questions Jesus. It came to pass, when Jesus had finished speaking these words to his disciples, that Marayam Magdalene came forward, kissed the feet of Jesus and said to him: "My Adanay, bear with me and be not wroth with me, if I question you; but have mercy upon us, my Adanay, and reveal to us all things on which we shall question you. Now, therefore, my Adanay, how does the First Mystery possess twelve mysteries, [and] the Ineffable possess an one and only mystery?"
Of the three mysteries and five mysteries. Jesus answered and said to her: "Indeed it possesses an one and only mystery, yet that mystery constitutes three mysteries, although

it is the one and only mystery; but the type of every one of them is different. And moreover it constitutes five mysteries, although it is an one and only one]; but the type of every one is different. So that these five mysteries are alike with one another in the mystery of the kingdom in the inheritances of the Light; but the type of each of them is different. And their kingdom is higher and more exalted than the whole kingdom of the twelve mysteries together of the First Mystery; but they are not alike in the kingdom [with the one and only mystery] of the First Mystery in the Light-kingdom.

"In like manner also the three mysteries are not [?] alike in the Light-kingdom; but the type of every one of them is different. And they themselves also are not alike in the kingdom with the one and only mystery of the First Mystery in the Light-kingdom; and the type of every one of the three of them, and the type of the configuration of each of them, is different from one another.

Of the first mystery. "The first [mystery of the First Mystery],--if you accomplish its mystery altogether and stand and accomplish it finely in all its figures, then do you come straightway out of your body, become a great light-stream and pass through all the regions of the rulers and all the regions of the Light, while all are in fear of that soul, until it comes to the region of its kingdom.
